newsitem.title: USA: Big Flower Press Holding Inc cuts Q4 loss.
newsitem.headline: Big Flower Press Holding Inc cuts Q4 loss.

text.p: NOTE: (a) Company issued 1.6 million shares to acquire Scanforms Inc in October 1996. Merger was accounted for as a pooling of interests and led to $900,000 in merger costs.

1996 Q4 adjusted results exclude compensation expenses of $2.7 million for Designer Color and Digital Dimensions acquisitions in December 1996, a loss of $14.3 million from the sale of Webcraft Games Inc, the $900,000 acquisition charge from Scanforms, and a $200,000 charge from prepayment of debt from one of its acquisitions. 1996 adjusted results reflect annual adjusted tax rate of 50 percent.
1995 adjusted Q4 results reflect initial public offering as if it were conducted on January 1, 1995. Interest expenses are reduced to reflect lower debt levels and reduced interest rates.
1995 adjusted Q4 excludes interest income earned on temporarily idle funds.

1995 adjusted Q4 reflects plant closing and relocation charges, the elimination of dividends on redeemable preferred stock, a marginal tax rate of 40 percent, and a $19.2 million loss on an interest rate swap agreement on certain debenture.
1995 adjusted Q4 does not include a $1.7 million premium from the repurchase of redeemable preferred shares.
Actual shares outstanding is adjusted for the 2-for-1 stock split in connection with the public offering.
